subject: inorganic
question:
无机化学·配位化学：请判断下列配合物的几何构型：Tetrakis(acetonitrile)copper(I)（[Cu(MeCN)₄]⁺）？
A. Tetrahedral
B. Square planar
C. Trigonal prismatic
D. Octahedral
explanation: Tetrahedral. Covalent count: Cu (group 11) 11 e; 4 × MeCN (L) 8 e; the 1+ charge removes 1 e: 18 e. Ionic count: the ligands carry no charge and the complex has a 1+ charge, so the metal is Cu(I), d¹⁰; d¹⁰ + 8 e from the ligands = 18 e.
